dhp44:1:
vicessati → vijessati iti (bahūsu) | vicessati → (yamaloka ji) ita sadevaka 
ko dhamapada sudeśita kuśala puṣaviva payeṣitī (prā. dha. C. 1.)
dhp45:4:
pacessati → budhu pra dha..... ṣiti yamaloka ji eta sadevaka. 
budhu dhamapada sudesita kuśala puṣaciva payeṣiti (prā. dha. C. 2.)
dhp47:4: gacchati → supataṃ vyāghraṃ mahogho vā mṛtyurādāya gacchati. saṃvinvānakamevainaṃ kāmānamavitṛtakam. (śāntiparva.9939. mahābhārata.)
dhp48:4: vasaṃ → puṣpāṇiva vicinavantamanyatragatamānasam. navāpteṣu kāmeṣu mṛtyurabhyeti mānavam. (śāntiparva. 6540.mahābhārata)
dhp58:4:
manoramaṃ → yadha sagara uḍasa ukdhitasa vaha partha 
padumu tatra jaea suyi gandha manoramu. (prā. dha. C 3)
dhp59:4:
sammāsambuddhasāvako → yadha sagha dhamā ā andhabhūte prædhijane. 
abhiotī prañai sammasabudha śavaka (prā. dha. C 4)
